text.p: Enstar Group Inc said it is rescheduling its annual shareholders meeting, originally scheduled to be held on April 28.

Enstar anticipates the annual meeting will be rescheduled for June 30. It said shareholders will be receiving in the near future notice of the new date for the annual meeting, the new record date for holders of the company's common stock entitled to vote at the annual meeting, and an amended proxy statement.

The postponement has been made necessary because of unanticipated problems and delays in the distribution of the company's new common stock to former shareholders and associated delays in many shareholders' receipt of notice of the annual meeting, Enstar explained.

The company said it is also considering nominating one or more additional members to the board of directors and will waive the sixty-day notice requirement under the bylaws for nomination of directors by shareholders.
